mentions.name: cuqueclicker
mentions.description: This is an idle clicker TUI game inspired by Cookie Clicker where you click an ass instead of a cookie. It runs locally with prebuilt binaries for every major platform, including a WASM port playable in the browser that saves game data to local storage.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am also (second post) working on an "idle clicker" like TUI game called "cuqueclicker", where you click an ass instead of a cookie (yeah, it's inspired by Cookie Clicker)
